points.quote: **`base`** holds foundation utilities and cross-platform abstractions. It has no services, and it contains `common`, `browser`, `node` and `parts` code. ... `base` depends on nothing above it.
**`platform`** holds the service infrastructure: dependency injection plus the service interfaces and implementations (files, configuration, storage, and so on).
**`editor`** is the Monaco text editor: the model, the view, language features and editing features.
**`workbench`** is the full application shell for desktop and web. ... `browser` holds the core UI (parts, layout, actions).
**`code`** is the Electron main-process code, which starts the desktop app.
**`server`** is the server-side code for remote and web hosting.
Dependencies point downward only. `base` depends on nothing above it. `platform` may use `base`. `editor` may use `base` and `platform`. `workbench` may use all of those.
`api` holds the extension host and the implementation of the VS Code extension API.
